entities.summary: Leszek Marian Kosedowski is a retired boxer from Poland, who won a bronze medal in the men's featherweight division at the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. There he was defeated in the semifinals by the eventual silver medalist, Richard Nowakowski of East Germany.
